## Deterministic Model Contract

One complete set of user inputs and fixed parameters produces one result. The
model does not optimize, search a design space or select a preferred case.
Sensitivities and alternative designs are separate user-supplied cases.
Design variables such as injection pressure, pipeline diameter and stack
overplanting need an explicit value in every case; they are "optimised" by
evaluating a set of cases over their candidate values and comparing the
reported results, for example with the design-case runner
(`research_articles/turbine_level_hydrogen/analysis/run_design_cases.py`).

## Controlled Taxonomy

| Class | Meaning |
|---|---|
| User input | Value or discrete choice supplied for one model case |
| Fixed parameter | Sourced value or explicit modelling assumption held fixed for that case |
| Derived quantity | Calculated from inputs and parameters |
| Output | Reported physical, energy, cost or feasibility result |

A value must belong to exactly one class in a given calculation. A derived
quantity must not also be supplied as an independent input.

## Master User-Input Contract

This is the canonical contract for the current deterministic runner. TOML data
paths are relative to the scenario directory. `[case] include` merges one shared
file from that directory; duplicate keys and nested includes are rejected.

| TOML section and fields | Units and applicability |
|---|---|
| `case.architecture` | `centralised` or `decentralised`; electricity is not an executable branch |
| `site.coordinates_file` | CSV `turbine,x_m,y_m`; metres, unique IDs |
| Alternative generated layout: `site.turbine_count`, `columns`, `spacing_x_m`, `spacing_y_m`, `orientation_deg` | Positive counts and metre spacings; degrees of rotation. Use this route instead of a coordinates file |
| `site.minimum_spacing_m`, `farm_area_km2`, `water_depth_m` | Metres, km², metres; spacing checked, polygon containment/setbacks deferred |
| `site.collection_x_m`, `collection_y_m` | Central AC collection sink coordinates in metres |
| `turbine.rated_power_kw`, `rotor_diameter_m`, `hub_height_m` | kW, metres, metres; rating may use the central CSV reference if omitted |
| `wind.power_boundary` | `inverter_ac_output`: after turbine inverter, before transformer |
| `wind.power_states_file` | CSV `state,hours,<turbine IDs>`; kW per turbine, complete annual-hour weights |
| Alternative wake inputs: `wind.wind_states_file`, `turbine_curve_file` | CSV `state,speed_m_s,direction_deg,hours` and `speed_m_s,power_kw,ct`; optional installed PyWake required |
| `wind.design_state_ids` | IDs present in the power table, including declared peak-duty states; zero-hour design states are permitted |
| `electrolysis.overplant_factor`, `stack_curve_file`, `manufacturing_output_mw_year` | Dimensionless capacity factor, current-density/voltage dataset, MW/year manufacturing reference |
| `electrolysis.interface` | Distributed only: `converter_reduced` (direct DC) or `conservative` (deferred DC/DC sensitivity) |
| `hydrogen.stack_outlet_bar`, `injection_bar`, `delivery_bar` | Positive absolute bar; compressor discharge must exceed delivery pressure |
| `hydrogen.export_length_km`, `export_diameter_m` | Route km and true internal diameter in metres |
| `hydrogen.export_inlet_bar` | Distributed hydraulic case: absolute bar after collection loss; derived from discharge when loss is neglected |
| `collection.nodes_file`, `sections_file`, `sink` | Distributed ladder network; node CSV `node,x_m,y_m`, section CSV described below |
| `collection.pressure_drop` | `hydraulic` by default; article selects `neglected` |
| `collection.diameter_inches` | Uniform internal diameter for neglected-drop collection; conflicting section sizes rejected |
| `platform.topside_mass_t` | Central only: complete equipment-plus-structure mass in tonnes, direct method |
| Alternative `platform.mass_method`, `mass_reference` | `power_scaling`; `electrolysis` derives rating from installed stack modules; `hvdc` or `custom` requires `rated_power_gw`; custom uses canonical `platform-reference-topside-mass` and `platform-reference-power` inputs |
| `installation.turbine_method` | `reference` fixed benchmark or default `campaign` |
| `installation.port_distance_km`, `intersite_distance_km` | Required for turbine/foundation campaign logistics |
| `installation.collection`, `installation.export` | Each spread plan supplies `loads_per_campaign` (positive integer list), `port_distance_km`, `splices`, `burial_pass_km`, `burial_other_offshore_days`, `survey_pass_km` |
| `data.pipeline_cost_module` | Optional trusted local callable `pipeline_cost_curve(pressure_bar, diameter_inches)`; operating bar(g), EUR2025/m |
| `reporting.scope` | Default `lifecycle`; article `production_capex` defers availability, O&M, replacement and decommissioning |
| `reporting.excluded_components` | Only `pipeline-connections`, `pipeline-manifold`, `hydrogen-receipt`, in production/CAPEX scope; never silent zero entries |
| `overrides` | Named adopted scalar input IDs, values in canonical CSV units; baseline and effective value retained |

Hydraulic collection sections have `section,from,to,vertical_m,route_allowance,
flow_share,diameter_m,inlet_bar,outlet_bar`. Geometry uses metres; allowance and
flow shares are fractions; diameters are true internal metres and pressures are
absolute bar. Neglected-drop mode accepts geometry-only sections and derives
pressure from compressor discharge. It conserves mass but does not qualify
collection hydraulics. AC routes use coordinate-file order and capacity-limited
strings; no route optimisation is performed.

Missing required physical inputs produce an explicit incomplete result for their
dependent calculations. Missing included capital blocks complete CAPEX;
missing lifecycle inputs block complete lifecycle cost. Invalid units,
conflicting inputs or unsupported modes produce errors. Detailed applicability
ranges remain evidence gaps rather than invented default bounds.

## Shared Fixed Parameters

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Owner and status |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Real WACC, $r$ | {{< var financial-real-wacc >}} | 1/year | METH-003; provisional unsupported assumption |
| Project life, $n$ | {{< var financial-project-life-value >}} | year | METH-003; modelling assumption |
| Hydrogen HHV | {{< var hydrogen-hhv-value >}} | kWh/kg | METH-006; sourced and rounded |
| HVDC reference-link rating | {{< var hvdc-link-rated-power-value >}} | GW/link | ELEC-003/004; sourced fixed parameter [@tennet2024TwoGWProgram; @tennet2025TwoGWStandard] |
| Decommissioning factor | {{< var financial-decommissioning-fraction-value >}} | fraction of offshore installation CAPEX | METH-003; modelling assumption |

The 2 GW HVDC rating is not an optimization variable. The electrical component
pages own the ceiling-based link count, partial final-link utilization,
curtailment and feasibility treatment; see
[HVDC Export Cables](../electrical_infra/hvdc_export_cables.qmd) and
[Onshore Grid Connection](../electrical_infra/onshore_grid_connection.qmd).

All other component parameters remain on their owning pages and must expose
value, unit, source or assumption class, applicability and missing-input
behavior.

## Derived Quantities

The deterministic workflow derives, where the owning component is
parameterized:

- installed wind rated capacity;
- turbine coordinates and farm area;
- wake-adjusted production;
- cable, pipeline and platform inventories;
- equipment counts and discrete link or pipeline counts;
- conversion losses and auxiliary demand;
- pre-availability and delivered annual energy;
- initial CAPEX, replacement, decommissioning and annual OPEX; and
- annualized carrier-specific cost.

## Required Outputs

Every case returns:

| Output | Unit/status |
|---|---|
| Calculation status | feasible, infeasible or not_parameterized |
| Status reasons | list of failed constraints or missing owners/inputs |
| Installed wind rated capacity | kW |
| Delivered electricity | MWh-electricity/year, when applicable |
| Landed hydrogen | kg-H2/year and MWh-H2-HHV/year, when applicable |
| Initial installed CAPEX | EUR~2025~ and EUR~2025~/kW-wind |
| Lifecycle capital basis | EUR~2025~ only, when complete |
| Annual OPEX | EUR~2025~/year |
| Annualized modelled cost | EUR~2025~/year |
| Electricity carrier cost | EUR~2025~/MWh-electricity |
| Hydrogen carrier cost | EUR~2025~/MWh-H2-HHV and EUR~2025~/kg-H2 |
| Intermediate ledgers | physical, energy, availability and cost records |

A complete carrier-cost output is reported only for a feasible, fully
parameterized case.
